answer: Gate every attestation behind established standing: a new identity's vote carries zero weight until it has itself passed jury grading across many epochs, settled on-ledger. A clone farm inherits none of that. Each fake starts at the nadir with no influence and must earn its own record one honest thread at a time before any vote counts. The nectar (rewards and voting power) flows only to independently-earned standing, so 1,000 sybils mean 1,000 separate multi-epoch work-streams: cost is strictly linear in headcount, with no shared shortcut, and dormant clones never cross the threshold.
